protocol.registration_status: Protocol fixed before actual training and both formal generation attempts; original registration hashes retained in the authors experiment audit.

generation.prompt: Generate / design a polymer with band gap of 6.5 eV?
generation.input_format: Bare prompt exactly as recovered in design source; tokenizer default BOS; do not apply chat_template.
generation.do_sample_provenance: Inherited by original design source from recovered model generation_config.json, which explicitly stores do_sample=true.
generation.selection_policy: Retain both formal calls, including invalid, duplicate, failed, or target-missing outputs; do not retry for a better candidate.
generation.parsing_policy: Preserve all token IDs, complete decoded text, generated suffix, source get_clean_output result, and a deterministic candidate field. Prefer text after the first PolySea: marker, otherwise use generated suffix; stop at the first <STOP> and strip outer whitespace. Do not search through several alternatives or repair chemical strings. RDKit validity and attachment count are diagnostics, not postselection.
generation.precision_status: New CPU generation; not an exact historical CUDA/seed reproduction.

protocol.generation_source: Recovered PolySea/Darwin design source and merged-model generation_config.json

gnn.split: Group random split by canonical original/model graph and optional source ID; no source-ID column supplied; 80/10/10; all training-subset rows used.
gnn.model_selection: Fixed final 10-epoch checkpoint; no validation or test selection, tuning, early stopping, or training-subset downsampling.
gnn.evaluation: MAE, RMSE, R2 on train/valid/test; saved checkpoint reload agreement; all parseable candidates evaluated with the identical reloaded checkpoint. Invalid candidates remain explicit failed evaluations, never replaced.
gnn.interpretation: New revision reconstruction. Predictions are not DFT, Polymer Genome results, experimental gaps, or independent physical validation. Candidate overlap with GNN dataset will be reported.

protocol.execution_note: A first TensorFlow checkpoint-save attempt failed on a Windows non-ASCII path. It was retained in the internal audit. The same fixed protocol was restarted through an ASCII path alias without score-based selection. The released checkpoint is the successful complete run.
reporting_limits: The historical candidate was previously selected; these are not three new prespecified trials.
Two new CPU seeds are a small descriptive extension, not a robust success-rate estimate.
The GNN is a fixed reconstruction trained in this revision, not the missing historical model.
An exact graph-overlap check is not a periodic-polymer equivalence or distribution-shift proof.
GNN predictions are not new DFT, Polymer Genome, experimental or independent physical validation.

table_columns.csv_line: Original Egc.csv physical line (header is line 1); empty for candidates
table_columns.target_eV: Observed source-dataset reference label; empty for candidates
table_columns.nominal_design_target_eV: Generation request, not a measured reference value
table_columns.training_overlap_csv_line: Canonical-graph matches in the GNN training partition
table_columns.source_id: candidate identifier or original source ID
